strategies.name: Donchian 20-Day Breakout (Swing)
strategies.entry: close > prior 20-day high AND close > SMA50

strategies.name: 20/50 EMA Pullback (Swing)
strategies.entry: EMA20>EMA50; prior low<=EMA20; close reclaims EMA20 & > prior close

strategies.name: RSI(2) Mean Reversion in Uptrend (Swing)
strategies.entry: close>SMA200; prior RSI(2)<10; short-term turn up

strategies.name: MACD Bullish Zero-Line Cross (Swing)
strategies.entry: MACD line crosses above signal AND line>0

strategies.name: Bollinger Lower-Band Reversion (Swing)
strategies.entry: close>SMA100; prior close<lower band; close re-enters band & > prior close

strategies.name: Golden-Cross 50-SMA Pullback (Swing)
strategies.entry: SMA50>SMA200; low<=SMA50; bullish close back above SMA50
